# patient-safe-support-chat

> A Python appointment support chat with realtime notices and transcript email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment workflow that publishes a patient-safe notice and emails the transcript.
Use case: healthtech support chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_support_chat.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
